This '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belazura]] occurred as a result of the machinations of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. His previous attempts to kill the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] failed, so Soresh recalled his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[X-7]]. The Rebels tracked him to Belazura. Using the mercenary [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]], the Rebels tried to turn X-7. X-7 was torn between his master and his new friends. In the battle to destroy the Imperial garrison on Belazura, Soresh ambushed the Rebels. The former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] was forced to kill X-7, but the garrison was destroyed. Imperial leader [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] demanded Soresh's arrest for his failure, but Soresh escaped into exile.

==Prelude==
Ambitious [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]], an important figure in the bureaucracy, used his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] to hunt down the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Previous [[Reconnaissance mission to Kamino|attempts]] to kill the Rebel pilot failed,<ref name="RF: Firefight" /> so Soresh recalled X-7 to [[Belazura]] for reconditioning.<ref name="RF: Trapped" />

During the attempt, X-7 had hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to assist him; one of them, [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]], was captured by Skywalker. Div was subsequently sprung from the [[Great Temple/Legends|his]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by unknown forces. Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] tracked down Div to Belazura with the help of a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and Div's former mentor, [[Ferus Olin]].<ref name="RF: Trapped" />

==The battle==
The Rebels recaptured Div and used him in a plot to turn X-7 to their side; Div acted that X-7 was in reality Div
s "brother," [[Trever Flume]]. The Rebels also planned to destroy the Imperial Garrison on Belazura to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Soresh calculated the Rebel's plan and tried to ambush them.<ref name="RF: Trapped" />

When the Rebels attacked the garrison and stymied the ambush, Soresh contacted X-7 to finish his mission. A confused X-7, who had come to accept his possible identity as Flume, shot Div in the shoulder to distract him, and raced to the garrison. To save Skywalker from X-7, Olin stabbed X-7 with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], fatally wounding him. Div held X-7 in his arms and told him that he mattered to someone in the end. The Rebels succeeded in destroying the garrison.<ref name="RF: Trapped" />

Angered that Soresh had interfered in his own search for Skywalker, Imperial leader [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered him detained, and posted a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] outside Soresh's office. Soresh, rightfully fearing for his life, activated his escape protocol and left Belazura. Angered at the failure, Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] the Lieutenant.<ref name="RF: Trapped" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Aftermath==
Commander Soresh had to escape Vader's wrath. He spent twenty-seven days on the run until he found sanctuary in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. He then set about planning his [[Battle of the Sixela system|revenge]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''. The repercussions would extend into the next book, ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'', the final in the series. Trever Flume was a character from the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series; ''Rebel Force: Trapped'' implies X-7 is actually Flume, but does not confirm it.
